description: Declarations of the consumer desktop renderer stylesheet built by PandaCSS. The reported 343-declaration baseline is its @layer utilities block.

extraction.denominatorRule: Alpha 1 baseline: every declaration except custom properties and declarations inside @keyframes, restricted to @layer utilities. Excluded declarations stay in the set with their reason.
extraction.selectorPolicy: Selectors are not published; only pseudo-classes, pseudo-elements and allow-listed state attribute names are kept.
extraction.redactionPolicy: url(), non-empty quoted strings, e-mail addresses, URIs, long opaque tokens and non-ASCII text are replaced by a placeholder carrying the SHA-256 of the removed text.
